question: If a creature with persist stops being a creature, does persist still work when it dies?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: persist still works if the permanent stopped being a creature.
expected.answer: If a creature with persist stops being a creature, persist will still work.

whyHard: Persist reads 'when this creature dies', so players think the permanent has to be a creature at the end.
